description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position:

Later is seeking a passionate Creative Director to lead our Creative Team and give the brand a distinct point of view in a category that gets louder every day. You will set the creative vision across Later’s brand, then make it real through integrated work spanning digital, video, print, and experiential/events. Reporting directly to the Head of Marketing, you will partner closely with Executive Leadership, Sales Leadership, Strategy Leadership, as well as Events and Growth Marketing teams to turn their priorities into creative that performs across both of Later’s core audiences: senior brand marketers and creators. This is a high-visibility role that sits on the marketing leadership team with regular exposure to executive leadership and direct influence on how the market understands and perceives Later.

This role is ideally a hybrid position with 3 days in office in our Boston or New York hubs, but remote applicants will be considered.

What you'll be doing:

Brand and creative strategy

  • Understand Later’s target audiences, market trends, business objectives, and business outcomes to help support and optimize marketing strategies with stakeholders
  • Own Later's brand and creative vision across digital, web, print, and experiential/events (in close collaboration with the events team)
  • Continue to innovate the creative vision to keep Later ahead of the curve
  • Lead concept development for integrated brand campaigns across digital, video, print, and experiential, built for the specific audiences we are trying to reach
  • Lead the evolution of Later’s imagery library while guiding the team to build a scalable process for sourcing, curating, and creating on-brand stock and AI-generated imagery
  • Use your knowledge of the sales cycle, content marketing, and the marketing funnel to streamline creative deliverables/processes for sales enablement and marketing tactics
  • Collaborate with marketing/brand experts to develop and evolve the company’s brand guidelines, empowering the team to apply them consistently and cohesively across all touchpoints  
  • Apply best practices and industry standards in brand and conversion design, incorporating persuasive elements, great calls-to-action, and effective use of visual hierarchy and storytelling techniques
  • Build trust through influence by sharing rationale for design decisions via data-driven insights

Team leadership

  • Provide strategic direction to coach and grow the Creative Team, ensuring they deliver impactful, on-brand work on time
  • Foster a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing, promoting best practices, and inspiring the team to push the boundaries of design excellence
  • Own the quarterly creative roadmap, including prioritization, resourcing, and timelines, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-impact work and delivering quality work on time
  • Conduct performance evaluations, quarterly coaching sessions, and provide constructive feedback to the team members to enhance their skills and improve their performance
  • Drive efficiency of the team by optimizing processes & workflow
  • Understand and manage internal stakeholder requirements and expectations
  • Set priorities and manage capacity across competing requests, making clear calls about what the team takes on and what it does not
  • Contribute to budget discussions, and manage spend and contractors

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with Content, Events, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Sales to turn strategic initiatives into creative that delivers business impact
  • Streamline creative intake, briefing, and review so partners know how to work with the team and what to expect
  • Represent Creative in Marketing planning and GTM motions, with regular exposure to senior leadership
  • Deliver consistent creative across Later's lines of business, including Later Influence, Later Social, and Later for Creators

Experimentation and performance

  • Partner with stakeholders to design and run tests on ads, landing pages, and campaign assets, from hypothesis through to result.
  • Analyze test outcomes, identify winning variations, and share what you learn so the next round of work starts smarter.
  • Apply insights to guide the team in refining the design of the customer journey, to improve engagement, conversion rates, and overall experience.
  • Track industry trends, emerging tools, and AI-assisted production methods, and bring the ones worth adopting into the team's workflow.

What success looks like:

  • Within the first 90 days, you know the brand, the team, and the request pipeline well enough to have a clear point of view on how Later's creative should look and where the current work falls short.
  • By 6 months, brand guidelines have evolved to reflect Later's ideal/new creative state and consistently applied, and creative intake and review move fast enough that partners stop routing around the process.
  • By 6 months, campaign creative is producing measurable lifts in engagement and conversion, with results shared back across Marketing.
  • Within 12 months, the Creative Team operates as a strategic partner rather than a service desk, with the capability, process, and staffing to support every line of business.
  • Within 12 months, Later's brand is visibly distinct in the influencer marketing category. Our brand identity and creative output is one of the reasons brands and creators take us seriously.

What you bring:

We are committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If you identify with any of the following, we encourage you to apply!

  • A portfolio with real range across digital, web, campaign, and print work, showing that the work performed and not just that it shipped.
  • Experience leading a Creative Team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Depth in creative strategy, concept development, and brand storytelling for a B2B or SaaS audience.
  • Fluency with Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma, and comfort directing work in whichever tools the team uses.
  • Comfort with marketing analytics and reporting, and a track record of using data to shape creative decisions.
  • Experience developing and reading A/B tests, and translating results into business and audience insight.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain creative thinking to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management instincts, and the ability to keep several workstreams moving in a fast-changing environment.
  • Hands-on understanding of generative AI design tools and workflows (such as Midjourney, Weave, Firefly, or similar), with a strong point of view on how to use them responsibly and on-brand.
  • Experience in the creator, social, or influencer marketing space is a bonus.
  • Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo or Klaviyo is a bonus.
  • Experience working in an agile marketing setup (Kanban, Scrumban, or similar) is a bonus.
  • Experience building a brand through a rebrand or repositioning is a bonus.

How we work: 

  • We will do whatever it takes to win: We win when our customers and creators win. We bring full commitment to outcomes that matter, not just effort.
  • We have no limit to our aspiration: We think big, push beyond what seems possible, and refuse to let conventional thinking set the ceiling.
  • We are relentless: We keep going. Through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities, we find a way forward.
  • We deeply understand our business: If we don't have the knowledge, we figure it out. We take ownership of understanding how Later works and what drives results.
  • We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: We bring rigor and accountability without ego, and we make space for each other to do our best work.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based and data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range: 

$160-200k OTE

#LI-Hybrid  #LI-Remote

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located. 

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, or age. Please let us know if you require any accommodations or support during the recruitment process.
